/arthritis-mental-health.question: Arthritis & Mental Health
/arthritis-mental-health.answer: Living with arthritis is not just a physical experience. Persistent pain, fatigue and uncertainty take a real toll on mood, sleep and identity. This evidence-based guide covers what to look out for, what helps, and where to get support — for you and the people around you.

/conditions/calcific-periarthritis.description: UK guide to calcific periarthritis: sudden shoulder or joint pain from calcium deposits in a tendon. Symptoms, causes, X-ray findings and treatment.
/conditions/calcific-periarthritis.question: Calcific Periarthritis
/conditions/calcific-periarthritis.answer: Calcific periarthritis is a sudden, intensely painful inflammation of the soft tissue around a joint, caused by deposits of calcium hydroxyapatite crystals forming inside a tendon or its surrounding tissue.

/exercises/ankle-arthritis-exercises.answer: Arthritis in the foot or ankle can make every step stiff and sore and leave you feeling unsteady. /guides/collagen-vs-glucosamine.answer: Collagen and glucosamine are the two supplements people ask about most when they want to try something over the counter for arthritis. Both claim to support cartilage and reduce joint pain, both are sold in every UK pharmacy and health shop, and both have a mixed evidence base that's easy to misread.

/guides/febuxostat-vs-allopurinol.question: Febuxostat vs Allopurinol for Gout
/guides/febuxostat-vs-allopurinol.answer: Allopurinol and febuxostat are the two urate-lowering drugs used long term to prevent gout attacks in the UK. Both lower blood uric acid by blocking xanthine oxidase, but they differ in effectiveness at standard doses, cardiovascular safety, kidney handling and UK healthcare availability.

/pedometer.question: Daily Step Counter
/pedometer.answer: Low-impact movement like walking helps lubricate joints, strengthens supporting muscles and reduces stiffness. Even short walks broken across the day can ease symptoms of osteoarthritis and rheumatoid arthritis. Build up gradually and stop if you feel sharp pain — consult your GP or physiotherapist if symptoms flare.

/safeguarding.answer: Living With Arthritis is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all individuals who engage with our services. We recognise our responsibility to take all reasonable steps to promote safe practice and to protect vulnerable adults from harm, abuse and exploitation.

/self-help.title: Virtual Physio Self-Help Tool | Living With Arthritis
/self-help.description: Interactive self-help tool for arthritis joint exercises. Click on any joint to discover targeted exercises for pain relief and mobility.
/self-help.question: Your Virtual Physio Assistant
/self-help.answer: Self-management combines four things UK physiotherapists know move the needle: gentle daily exercise tailored to the painful joint, pacing activity to avoid boom-and-bust days, weight management to reduce joint load, and short courses of NSAIDs or paracetamol for flares.

/supplements/collagen-alternatives.title: Collagen Alternatives for Joints: UK Evidence Guide
/supplements/collagen-alternatives.description: Vegan, halal and allergy-safe alternatives to collagen for arthritis: turmeric, glucosamine, MSM, omega-3, vitamin C and D, with evidence and caveats.
/supplements/collagen-alternatives.question: Collagen alternatives for joints
/supplements/collagen-alternatives.answer: There is no such thing as vegan collagen, but you do not need collagen to support your joints.

/supplements/collagen.title: Collagen for Arthritis: Does It Work? UK Evidence Guide
/supplements/collagen.description: Does collagen help arthritis? An honest UK guide to hydrolysed and type II collagen: what trials show, safety, medicine interactions and what works better.
/supplements/collagen.question: Collagen Supplements for Arthritis: What the Evidence Really Shows (UK Guide)
/supplements/collagen.answer: Checked on 10 October 2026 against Arthritis UK's collagen page, NICE NG226 and the published trials listed below. This page is general education, not a recommendation to buy any product.
/supplements/collagen.breadcrumb: Collagen Supplements for Arthritis: What the Evidence Really Shows (UK Guide)

/supplements/glucosamine.title: Glucosamine for Arthritis: Does It Work? UK Guide
/supplements/glucosamine.description: UK guide to glucosamine for arthritis: what the evidence says, sulfate vs HCl, dosage, side effects and how it compares to chondroitin, MSM and collagen.
/supplements/glucosamine.question: Glucosamine for arthritis
/supplements/glucosamine.answer: Evidence is mixed, and NICE advises healthcare professionals not to offer glucosamine for osteoarthritis. It is not a cure and should not replace exercise or recommended treatment. Ask a pharmacist before trying it, especially if you take warfarin or other medicines.

/supplements/msm.title: MSM Supplement for Joint Pain: UK Guide & Evidence
/supplements/msm.description: What is MSM (methylsulfonylmethane)? An honest UK guide to the evidence for joint pain and arthritis, dosage, side effects and use with glucosamine.
/supplements/msm.question: MSM for joint pain
/supplements/msm.answer: MSM is an organic sulfur compound (methylsulfonylmethane). Small trials at 1,500–3,000 mg/day show modest reductions in knee osteoarthritis pain and stiffness over 12 weeks. It is well tolerated and often combined with glucosamine sulfate. Evidence is weaker than for curcumin or glucosamine alone.

/symptom-checker.title: Arthritis Symptom Checker (UK): Educational Guide Finder
/symptom-checker.description: Free UK arthritis symptom checker: red-flag screen, joint areas, duration and severity, with links to condition, exercise, diet and PIP guides.
/symptom-checker.question: Arthritis symptom checker
/symptom-checker.answer: Use this checker to organise symptoms and open relevant Living With Arthritis guides on conditions, exercise, diet and PIP. If you have emergency symptoms such as a suddenly hot red joint with fever, or loss of bladder or bowel control with back pain, call 999. For urgent non-emergency advice, contact NHS 111.

/zakat-appeal.title: Gaza Zakat & Sadaqah | Living With Arthritis
/zakat-appeal.description: Give Zakat or Sadaqah to support physiotherapy and rehabilitation for war and trauma survivors in Gaza. Learn how donations help. Gift Aid not yet live.
/zakat-appeal.question: Zakat Appeal
/zakat-appeal.answer: In Gaza, thousands of people are living with crushed joints, amputations, nerve damage and pain that never lets go. Hospitals that survived are overwhelmed, and rehabilitation — the slow, patient work of learning to move again — is one of the first things to disappear.
